mainText: If you want to get involved, sponsor us, need help planning a pollinator garden, or have any questions for us, we’d love to hear from you.
volunteerText: Looking for a way to get involved with the Pollinator Pathways Project? We’d love your contribution. We’re currently looking for growers, writers, and gardeners. Email us to get started!

volunteerOpportunities.title: Writers
volunteerOpportunities.text: We are looking for a writer to join our community group,  someone who can contribute a blog article (300-500 words) once a month or a social media post once a week. As a writer, you need not have extensive experience with writing. Ideally, you should have some interest in environmental conservation and protection of wild species.

volunteerOpportunities.title: Growers
volunteerOpportunities.text: We're looking for growers who can be responsible for over-winter and spring seedlings. For the overwinter seedlings, we’ll provide you with all the materials needed (seedling starting trays, humidity domes, 1020 growing trays, potting mix, seeds) and a detailed instruction on how to grow seedlings from seeds overwinter. For spring seedlings, we’ll also provide you with all the materials needed (mini greenhouse, grow lights, power bar, seedling starting trays, 1020 growing trays, seed staring mix, seeds) and a detailed instruction on how to grow seedlings from seeds, and assemble a mini greenhouse, in the spring.

volunteerOpportunities.title: Gardeners
volunteerOpportunities.text: We are looking for volunteers to help keep our public gardens beautiful and pollinators happy by maintaining a good mix of pollinator plants and keeping the gardens tidy and watered. Gardener volunteers may help with weeding, watering, and planting. No experience necessary, we look forward to hearing from you!
